batch: OLP-0159–0166 First-order Logic semantics under the complete classical first-order profile
method: Fresh comparison of every exact frozen-English and Gujarati linguistic block, with independently worded reverse paraphrases for 61 representative substantive blocks. The review focuses on structures and their universes, closed-term values and coverage, assignment-relative recursive satisfaction, assignment independence, semantic extensionality, substitution, validity, entailment, satisfiability and all eleven adjacent disclosed source repairs.
